capabilities: Add today's recorded work to the daily note
Write time per project and task
Auto-update the daily note on an interval
Create the daily note if it is missing
disambiguation: Not a task-completion or checklist plugin; it imports time-tracking records from the DoneThat service into your daily note.
extras: Requires a paid DoneThat plan (Core or above) for API access; the API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage, not the settings file. Only edits the region between two markers in the note. No telemetry or analytics; only the DoneThat API is contacted.
problem: Time tracked in the DoneThat service is not reflected in your Obsidian daily notes, so notes don't show what you actually worked on each day.

relations.evidence: This plugin brings that record into your vault, so each daily note shows what you actually did that day.

requires.name: DoneThat API key with reports:read scope

summary: Plugin that adds DoneThat's recorded work to your daily note: the day's total and time per project and task.
